summary: Frontend-only verification of the footer-bottom responsive fix on greenwebsite.co.id clone across mobile (390px), tablet (768px) and desktop (1440px). All stated acceptance criteria pass: 1) Mobile shows column layout, 11px gray copyright on a single line, green links left-aligned below, divider inset ~16px, padding-bottom 96px so the floating WhatsApp button does not cover the text; 2) Links navigate to /kebijakan-privasi and /syarat-ketentuan correctly; 3) No horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth===innerWidth===390) on both / and /layanan/mobile-app; 4) Tablet 768px and Desktop 1440px keep flex-row layout with copy left and links right on one row.

design_issues.screen: Footer bottom at tablet 768px and desktop 1440px (NOT in scope of this request)
issues: Floating WhatsApp button vertically/horizontally overlaps the right-aligned 'Kebijakan Privasi · Syarat & Ketentuan' links at the bottom-row when scrolled to the very end (desktop screenshot shows 'Syarat & Ketentuan' partially occluded by the Chat WhatsApp pill). Mobile 390px is unaffected because padding-bottom:96px provides clearance. Consider adding padding-bottom clearance or hiding WA button when footer intersects, for tablet/desktop.

critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx line 181: copyright uses `new Date().getFullYear()` which renders '2026' as intended in Jan-2026 — fine, matches reference image.
App.css mobile media (max-width:640px) adds padding-bottom:96px to .footer-bottom to clear floating WA — good, prevents WA from covering footer text on small screens.
The .footer-bottom divider uses border-top on an element nested inside .container (which has side padding), so the line is naturally inset — matches reference.

Minor: on tablet/desktop the floating WA button can overlap the right-aligned footer-bottom links when scrolled to the bottom; consider the same padding-bottom clearance strategy or auto-hide behavior at wider breakpoints. Not required by this task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified only the footer-bottom responsive changes. Playwright inspected computed styles at 390/768/1440, confirmed border-top inset, 11px font-size, muted gray copyright, green links, no horizontal overflow, link navigation works, and WA button clearance at mobile. Screenshots saved under /app/.screenshots/footer_*.png.
